name: Efka Engineering System
scope: Standalone control layer. Modules (model gateway, sandbox, eval, agents) are external and are only verified through adapters.

components.purpose: readiness of toolchain, agent surfaces, MCP, repos, secret files, disk
doctor + secret scan + every adapters/*/verify.ps1, with JSON/TXT logs and 60-run retention
high-confidence credential scan by filename and content
enforces the review contract: evidence per finding, observed tests for approve, independence flag
new project with AGENTS.md, .gitignore, .gitattributes, check.ps1, git baseline
TaskSpec, ExecutionSpec, JobState, definition of done
agent skill: run and interpret the gate
INSTALL, ARCHITECTURE, MODULES, GATES, CONTRACTS, MEMORY, TOOLCHAIN, SCORE, GEMS

invariants: core/ contains no host names, user paths, or product-specific logic
no credential values in the repository; configuration reads environment variables
installs are generated from this repository; no manual copies
every check is read-only and returns a meaningful exit code
unsupported capability means BLOCKED, never a silent fallback
a review finding without evidence is rejected by the validator

adapters.description: Host/module-specific layers live outside core/ and are never copied to other machines.
adapters.contract: adapters/<name>/verify.ps1 is executed automatically by the gate as section adapter:<name>
